news_synthesis: Recent headlines over the last 28 days center on Vinicius Junior's club and international involvement. On the club side, coverage references Mourinho seeking a "killer" Vinicius as Real Madrid face Rayo, and a Rayo Vallecano manager naming a Real Madrid figure he would remove from the team. On the international side, multiple headlines report Vinicius Jr among the players leading Brazil's squad for a historic clash against India, set within a broader Brazil rebuild under Ancelotti following the World Cup, with Neymar and Casemiro out and Raphinha in.
